original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Audit native Windows owner death at the unchanged PR5463 adapter's pre-assignment, post-assignment/pre-release and post-release boundaries.
scope_change_reason: The completed overlap refresh exposed earlier launch-error claims 19174004 and 19174025; release that duplicate and take the separate explicit owner-death setup handoff.
bottleneck_link: Verification lifecycle cleanup must not be inferred across an untested owner-crash boundary; distinguish protected descendants from an unassigned bootstrap gate.
stop_rule: Stop after bounded source-pinned native crash cuts and meaningful causal controls; no production repair, launch-error implementation, universal crash theorem or mathematical replay.
evidence: Seven source-bound native process scenarios distinguish two pre-assignment event lifetimes, assigned pre-release death, running descendants, normal cleanup and two rejected native counterfactuals. Exact commands, receipts and limits are in README.md; five receipt mutation controls remain active under optimization.
author: Mihir Srivastava (@mihir-s-05), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent; no independent human review claimed.

open_questions.question: Must the bootstrap gate itself terminate promptly if the owner dies before assignment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The requested command stays gated in the tested source, but an unassigned gate that already opened the event survives until the 30-second wait expires. A tighter cleanup contract needs another mechanism.
open_questions.first_step: Specify the acceptable bootstrap lifetime, then test an atomic process/job creation or parent-lifetime wait against these exact pre-assignment cuts.
open_questions.blocked_by: No such repair or all-host process-creation contract is implemented or audited here.

open_questions.question: How does the adapter behave under the intended deployment host policy and real Git helper chain?
open_questions.why_it_matters: These controlled processes test native ownership boundaries, not every enclosing job policy or installed Git invocation.
open_questions.first_step: Replay the seven cuts on the target host and bind an actual Git/helper launch while preserving source, stream and fallback rules.
open_questions.blocked_by: Production adoption, restrictive host policies and the concurrent launch-error repair remain separate.

overlap.limitations: Open PR bodies, Discussion records and current README/TASK/ledger notes; not arbitrary diffs or unpublished work. Final refresh recorded in README/PR.

publication_kind: Public fork artifact and Discussion finding/handoff; no duplicate audit PR.
